tables.name: propFunctionSystem
tables.merge: Merge SYS_MAIL only, resolve product NumID collisions and regenerate using the product exporter. Never replace the complete product table.

integration: Install MailEntity and MailSystem using existing Oathx entity/system discovery. Use SystemActive/SystemDetive through the product coordinator.
Home Mail routing in Integration/MasterSystem.cs is a reference only. Do not overwrite product Master or require Home to install Mail.
Restore materials and adjacent meta GUIDs. Common font files may already exist: compare hashes before reuse; resolve conflicting GUIDs through Unity asset tooling.
MailExample.json is optional and explicitly local. Supply ReplaceInbox data before first activation to replace the example, or clear UIMail.example for an empty inbox.
Claims record in-memory receipts only. No inventory grant, service connection, persistence, timer-driven expiry or account-switch contract is provided.
Fixed labels are serialized in the prefab. Runtime fixed product messages belong in propCommonText; message bodies are host data.

Mail uses VList<VMRewardEntry> and a nested RewardEntry.prefab. Install RewardEntry v6 first; migrate old UIMailReward/VMMailReward scripts with their meta GUIDs using its migration.json. Do not keep duplicate old class files.
RewardEntry v6 requires ItemSlot v5. Mail constructs reward.Item and updates Item.Text/Icon/IconVisible; old reward Count/Icon fields no longer exist.

Icon is a string asset path resolved by existing SyncSprite/UILoader. IconVisible expresses host visibility intent, not loading completion. Mail does not load Sprite or maintain image callbacks. Shared loader cancellation and out-of-order completion need separate validation.

dependencies.name: FunctionSystemConfig
dependencies.reason: Regenerate and load the function registry before activating MailSystem.

dependencies.name: RewardEntry
dependencies.reason: Shared UIRewardEntry/VMRewardEntry, nested prefab and reward artwork; install before Mail.
